name: Gotharman SpazeBoard6
description: Gotharman SpazeBoard6: every parameter its manual lists as controllable by CC, a part's on that part's channel.

sources.title: SpazeBoard6 user manual 82.03
sources.notes: The list of parameters controllable by CC (PDF pages 374 - 376), read by tools/profiles/gotharman/read-gotharman-manual.mjs from SPAZEboard6_USER_MANUAL_82_03.pdf (sha256 087adceed1c783991fa52f0bba15695a93a6a1cfff0664f9857295608d2dbeb8), https://gotharman.dk/onewebmedia/SPAZEboard6%20USER%20MANUAL%2082_03.pdf, linked from https://gotharman.dk/earlier_designs. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/gotharman/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/gotharman/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the manual's list of parameters controllable by CC, sent 0 - 127 (the manual gives no ranges): a part's on the variable partChannel, "MIDI channel are equal to part number", the instrument's on the channel variable, its global channel. The instrument answers only with its MIDI In mode set to Omni, Omni Thru, Multi-Timbral or Multi-Timbral/Thru and PccIN (Parameter CC Input) on; CClayr says whether the selected morph layer or both are set. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
